items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: But out of that you got Jimmy Bertrand. ... Davy was fortunate enough to be around Jimmy Bertrand.

ctx.x: That's the reason they started to call them guys percussionists, but now you must remember, the greatest drummer that ever lived was out in Chicago, that played with the Silas Green Show. His name was Manzie Campbell, But by Mancy being out of Chicago but being on the road on tour down South, nobody got a chance to see him. But out of that you got Jimmy Bertrand.
